content:
Heather Macbeth, Ursula Martin, Patrick Massot, Natarajan Shankar, and I are co-organizing Big Proof 2025 at the Isaac Newton Institute in Cambridge, UK, from 9 June to 13 June 2025:

https://www.newton.ac.uk/event/bprw03/

The workshop is open to the public, but registration is required. Invited speakers include:

  • Kevin Buzzard
  • Alex Best
  • Mario Carneiro
  • Alex Davies
  • William Timothy Gowers
  • Paola Iannone
  • Mateja Jamnik
  • Angeliki Koutsoukou-Argyraki
  • Wenda Li
  • Sophie Morel
  • Emily Riehl
  • Aidan Swope
  • Fenner Tanswell
  • Terence Tao
  • Ravi Vakil
  • Maryna Viazovska

Unfortunately, we cannot offer funding beyond the invited speakers.

Please circulate this announcement!
I hope the talks will be recorded and available to the public later?
The INI generally records the talks and makes them available (with the speakers' permission).
The closing date for the first round of applications is 2nd March, so please apply at https://www.newton.ac.uk/event/bprw03/ if you’d like to participate.

Is it possible for someone not affiliated with a university to apply for registration? The application asks for relevant research activities, which I have none other than my own explorations. Is it reasonable to try to attend this event as someone that it's interested in participating more closely in the community (but with no current formal affiliation)?
You should apply anyway, and we’ll see what we can do.
Sorry, just saw this, and the deadline is yesterday... Would there be a second round of applications?

Zephyr Fan said:

Sorry, just saw this, and the deadline is yesterday... Would there be a second round of applications?

Same! Is it still possible to apply?
We will see depending on what was received.
I'm hoping that the deadline for applying for virtual attendance may be extended! :fingers_crossed:
I’d also really hope for a second round of applications!

The Big proof meeting is about to start! Talks will be live-streamed at https://www.newton.ac.uk/news/watch-live/. There is also a dedicated Zulip channel at #Big Proof 2025 . The first talk will be given by Kevin Buzzard about the FLT project at 2025-06-09T10:15:00+02:00.
(Note the time above is incorrect, it should be 2025-06-09T19:15:00+10:00, i.e. now!)
